title: Good radius: a level in (ρ, ρ') with a prescribed a.e. property, a μ-null sphere and a Markov bound
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let μ be a measure on (the Borel sets of) ℝ^P, y ∈ ℝ^P, and ρ < ρ' real numbers. Let g : ℝ → [0, ∞] be L¹-a.e. measurable (L¹ = Lebesgue measure on ℝ), let I ∈ [0, ∞] with ∫_ℝ g dL¹ ≤ I (lower Lebesgue integral), and let p be a property of real numbers holding for L¹-a.e. t ∈ ℝ. Assume μ(B̄_{ρ'}(y)) < ∞. Then there is t ∈ ℝ with ρ < t < ρ' such that p(t) holds, μ(∂B_t(y)) = 0, where ∂B_t(y) = {x ∈ ℝ^P : |x − y| = t} (Metric.sphere y t), and g(t) ≤ (2/(ρ' − ρ))·I, the product being computed in [0, ∞] as ENNReal.ofReal(2/(ρ' − ρ))·I.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (y : Euclid P) (ρ ρ' : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (I : ℝ≥0∞) (p : ℝ → Prop), ρ < ρ' → μ (closedBall y ρ') ≠ ∞ → AEMeasurable g → ∫⁻ t, g t ≤ I → (∀ᵐ t, p t) → ∃ t : ℝ, ρ < t ∧ t < ρ' ∧ p t ∧ μ (sphere y t) = 0 ∧ g t ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 / (ρ' - ρ)) * I
